steps.content: Outside of the Executive Committee's secret branch, several teams of Executive Officers are on standby. From time to time, violent tremors can be heard from inside.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: So many Executive Officers have been dispatched. Are they here to help ${PlayerName} fight?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Their movements are so sharp and clean-cut. They're a lot stronger than regular execs. The Executive Committee has never produced such a strong team before.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Also, ${PlayerName} is supposed to be fighting the monster. Why didn't they go in to help... Kinda weird.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Tsk, there's no time. In any case, he's not doing well in there. We need to hurry. Let's find a blind spot to break in and find ${PlayerName}.
steps.female_content: Tsk, there's no time. In any case, she's not doing well in there. We need to hurry. Let's find a blind spot to break in and find ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: If all goes well, we can bring him back the same way without getting noticed. I suspect these people at the door have other plans... that won't be good for ${PlayerName}.
steps.female_content: If all goes well, we can bring her back the same way without getting noticed. I suspect these people at the door have other plans... that won't be good for ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: All right.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: ...So this is an Executive Committee detention center! Could those imprisoned here be...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Where did they all go? Did the monster already...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Calm down! Don't think about the what-ifs right now. The first thing we have to do is find ${PlayerName}. It's too late to think about anything else.
Gritting his teeth and clenching his fists, he strides forward, hoping to concentrate.
After running forward a bit, they hear feeble moans amidst the chaotic sounds. It's coming from a cell nearby.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Someone's there? This way!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ${PlayerName}?!

He barges into the cell, only to see a stranger infected with Mania on the ground, tormented by extreme mental pain. Several others rush in behind him, and the most decisive one quickly shoots the infectee to put him out of his misery.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Is this just a coincidence... It's just one person, yet...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Taran... Look at these marks, could it be...
The familiar drawing style and Rustfire marks are what the elite team used in training. Taran's pupils dilate. He almost roars out in fury, and uses his last shred of sanity to issue a final warning.
This was a trap. Someone lured him to this room on purpose to make him see what happened to the elite team.
Bang—the cell door suddenly slams shut, cutting them off from their companions and locking them inside. A hologram lights up in the darkness, and a woman's voice begins to speak.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Hello.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: The current situation's not looking good for you. But you have the chance to make a choice.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Surrender. Everyone has the chance to make that new choice.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Everyone... Did you also say this to the people locked up in this room?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: If you're talking about the elite Rustfire combatants, then yes. They got that chance, too.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: They all surrendered.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: That's impossible! What did you do to them? What happened to them here?!!

They hear a hail of gunfire and screams outside the door, followed by silence. The faces of everyone in the room become as white as paper. Taran's sanity finally snaps. He whips out his gun, trying to find the source of the voice.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: While everyone gets a fair chance, we don't have much time to convince everyone.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: So think about your choice, my friends. You are responsible for your own choices.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Kill us, then what...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: We're all tough nuts in Rustfire. As long as Syndicate still exists, there will be those who resist you. The more people you kill, the more people will turn against you.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Don't think you can trample us under your feet.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Actually, I can. I can issue a Purge Order, but it's costly. I had to optimize the plan and borrow your "leader."

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Your beloved leader is here. The one you trust, depend on, and whose name you've used to recruit so many to join Rustfire. His choices have great appeal.
steps.female_content: Your beloved leader is here. The one you trust, depend on, and whose name you've used to recruit so many to join Rustfire. Her choices have great appeal.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: All we need is for him to join us, and he will do so soon.
steps.female_content: All we need is for her to join us, and she will do so soon.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: He's not that kind of person! He'll never be corrupted by you!
steps.female_content: She's not that kind of person! She'll never be corrupted by you!

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Perhaps. But it doesn't really matter what he does.
steps.female_content: Perhaps. But it doesn't really matter what she does.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: All we need to do is show everyone that he "chose" us. As long as we bring him back to Nirvana, we can publish whatever news we want about what he says and does.
steps.female_content: All we need to do is show everyone that she "chose" us. As long as we bring her back to Nirvana, we can publish whatever news we want about what she says and does.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: As soon as we send out this news, Rustfire will fracture from the inside. People will start to have doubts and think about other options. They will no longer be united and start to distrust or attack each other.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Remember that "leader" who betrayed you eight years ago? He released several public statements of capitulation.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Those were all fake. He simply wasn't awake, nor did we need him to wake up to express any statements.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Just making you think he betrayed you is enough. After all, that was your leader.
Taran's breathing speeds up, and his bloodshot eyes blur his vision.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...It was you. It was all your conspiracy.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Our demands weren't unreasonable... Yet you chose to massacre us... You think Syndicate deserves to live under your oppression...?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Alright. I have no time to convince every single person. Your choice is...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Go to hell!!!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Taran! Watch out!! Ah...!

<size=30>A hail of gunfire goes off at the same time as the boy's hysterical roar. The rage and despair gets transmitted to the other end of the comms, but does not affect the woman one bit. She goes through the files of all the Rustfire members at the scene, before finally stopping at Taran's file.</size>

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: What a nice young man. Open the door when he's the only one left.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: He's perfect.
